entries.name: Blair Anderson

expected.charges: Attempted murder; weapons charges (indicted, later dropped)
expected.sentence:
Wounded survivor of the Dec 4, 1969 Chicago police raid on Fred Hampton's apartment. Indicted with the other raid survivors; the indictments were dropped after police lab evidence was shown to be falsified.

Verdict as recorded: No — indictments dropped after falsified police lab evidence was exposed

entries.rationale: The court describes the arrest and imprisonment of the seven raid survivors on December 4, 1969; the Commission of Inquiry names Anderson among those arrested and held. The December 13 Black Panther report specifically describes Anderson in hospital under armed guard after surgery. Custody began with the raid, including guarded hospitalization, not an inferred later jail transfer. Individual release remains unverified.
